dataset.source: Smith et al. (2026) Water Research 288:124685; detailed data shared by the authors (L. Haupert, U.S. EPA) on 10 Nov 2026; processed subset simulation/data/smith2026_aex_detailed.csv

protocol.notScorable: S4, K0 and the model-free 4 ng/L comparison (A2 8.4): no MRL value in the files, the paper or the SI (A3 9.3.4)
implementationNotes: Correction: the primary analyses (E6, E7, E8 on all samples) are rerun; the sensitivity run without the flagged outliers is not repeated. Experiment 2 run times are multiplied by EBCT from run time / EBCT used in A1, per train and bed (headers of smith2026_aex_detailed.csv and smith2026_aex_columns.csv).

Repeat: a target's values at a cut-off are ng/L divided by the mean influent of that train and species on or before the cut-off; starting curves, E8 and the reference scatter use the mean of all influent samples of the train.

Repeat: cut-offs K1, K2 and the E7 cut-off are the first port sample whose ng/L reaches the level times the mean influent on or before that sample's time. K3 and K4 are 1/3 and 1/2 of the train's record, as before.
Repeat: influent non-detects (5 rows, Experiment 2 +NOM, one each of PFOS x2, PFBS, PFNA, PFOA) count as 0 ng/L in the influent means, as all non-detects do (A2 8.3.4).

Repeat E6 uses the case-independent code of external_validation_aex.e6 (summary, reference scatter, verdict) with the case function below; repeat E7 mirrors external_validation_aex.e7 with the cut-off and C0 rule of A2.
S4, K0 and the model-free 4 ng/L comparison (A2 8.4) are not run: no MRL value is given (A3 9.3.4).

correction.note: E6-E8 on the workbook data with Experiment 2 run times corrected (A3 9.3.2); labelled as a correction, the primary results stay the registered ones
